name: WS Games Center (Base)
description: This edition brings a Rollback System, where if you like the look of an older version (currently supported: v14.1, v14.2, v14.3), you can go to Settings > Beta Testing and you can change. PLEASE NOTE: Your launcher will NOT connect to WS Game Services below v14.2. If you aren’t able to see below 14.2, it is because your launcher was given a PCSU (Patch Client System Update) because of system integrity. Plus a bunch of bugfixes and UI updates.
